entries.605e5efc62870a0b: Following three consecutive fiscal years of losses, it launched “Emergency Management Reform 2026” and has set returning to profitability in the fiscal year ending March 2027 as its top priority. Three basic strategies are set: strengthening portfolios by market and by product together with customer response that emphasizes speed; sweeping cost reform; and rigorous review and strict execution of plans, together with strengthening governance and human capital, and it will promote a fundamental reform of its earnings structure.
